title: How do drugs know where to go in the body?
description: Listen to this episode from The React Rooms  on Spotify. Ever wondered how a tiny pill knows exactly where to act in your body? Does it have a GPS? A brain? Magic? Nope—just brilliant chemistry and biology at play! In this episode, we break down how drugs find their targets, whether it's a painkiller heading for your headache or an antibiotic fighting off a throat infection. Join us as we explore receptors, lock-and-key mechanisms, and smart drug delivery systems—all in simple, fun language!

title: The dream that gave us Benzene
description: Listen to this episode from The React Rooms  on Spotify. What does a snake biting its own tail and one of the most important molecules in chemistry have in common? Discover the chemistry behind one of the most iconic moments in scientific history—and why benzene is far more special than it first appears.

title: Why bananas are slightly radioactive?
description: Listen to this episode from The React Rooms  on Spotify. Did you know your favorite fruit is glowing… scientifically speaking? Tune in to find out if you really need to worry about your banana smoothie—or if this is just one of nature’s quirky little facts.

title: Carbenes
description: Listen to this episode from The React Rooms  on Spotify. Join Simran Ailani and Lawanya Deshmukh, passionate chemistry students as they discuss the fascinating world of carbenes in this engaging podcast episode. From exploring the stability and reactivity of these short-lived but powerful chemical species to discussing their real-world applications in pharmaceuticals and materials science, this episode offers a clear and insightful look into why carbenes matter. The duo also shares thoughts on the future potential of carbene chemistry in green technology and advanced synthesis, making this a must-listen for students, educators, and chemistry enthusiasts alike.

title: The secrets of Sadabahar
description: Listen to this episode from The React Rooms  on Spotify. What if the common Sadabahar flower held a secret that changed medicine? In this episode of The React Rooms, discover the fascinating story of how a failed diabetes study led to the discovery of vincristine, a life saving chemotherapy drug—and why sometimes extraordinary discoveries are hidden in the most ordinary places!
